why: The conjecture itself remains unproven, but its own lower-bound quantity was improved: a paper 'Towards Solving the Gilbert-Pollak Conjecture via Large Language Models' (arXiv 2601.22365) reports an LLM-driven system certifying a new lower bound of 0.8559, up from the 1985 bound of ~0.824168, and a GitHub PR in Terence Tao's optimizationproblems repo cites a further certificate-layer lower bound of 0.860.
